question: If 23 A 64 A 13 = 136423 and 9 A 57 A 12 = 12579, then 29 A 4 A 6 = ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• 23 A 64 A 13 = 136423

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0b777edff5352296092577acbe5005882d18a19ce8d1056888a759073d7598.png] 

and,

 
• 9 A 57 A 12 = 12579

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31201d9938e49567d9f25d07bab0468308922100c6b0cd27d26c8841f3a2534f.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **29 A 4 A 6 = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02944265b66e5925429ee9d7cc7891150711ab9611c93c42cd850baa916d504f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"6429".**
